_comment: Hand-verified Rotten Tomatoes paths for video entries whose Wikidata item has none (or which have no Wikidata item). Keyed by imdb_id. A null rotten_tomatoes_id records that Rotten Tomatoes has no page for the work. Each was checked against the page title on rottentomatoes.com on the verified date. scripts/videos_fetch_wikidata.py writes these into the yaml and reports any that Wikidata has since caught up with (drop those here); scripts/check_wikidata_ids.py checks the yaml against them. See CLAUDE.md.
